title: The Silver Hand: The Oath

texts.details:
You have sworn to protect the weak. Everyone says the words. I want to know whether you meant them.

There is a Defias cutthroat working the river road east of here, a man named Ned Carrow. He does not rob merchants. He robs farm wives walking to market, because they cannot fight back. The Marshal has no one to spare for him.

That is what your oath is for, $N. Not dragons. Go and deal with him.
texts.objectives: Kill Ned Carrow among the Defias east of Goldshire, then return to Brother Wilhelm.
texts.progress: He will run from a guard. He will not expect a paladin.
texts.completion:
Then the road is safe for those who had no one else. Remember how small it was, $N. Nearly all of the work is that small.

Now I will tell you something about the order you have joined. It is young. I knew men who were there when it was made. Its founder, its first knight, its greatest traitor and its dead all lie within a few weeks' ride of this chapel.

I mean for you to visit them. Each will teach you what the Light is for, and no two of them agree. Choose one of these. When you have twenty seasons, go to the Cathedral in Stormwind and ask for Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker.

idea: The Silver Hand, level 10 (Alliance, Elwynn): the oath put to a small test. Invented: Ned Carrow.
